title: rhythm-tuner notification
description: What rhythm-tuner scan --notify webhook+https://... posts: the findings that are new since the --since report, at or above --notify-min. No evidence or response bodies are included and anything that looks like a secret is masked. Schema rhythm-tuner-notify/v0 may still change before v1.0; new optional fields can appear in any release.

version.description: The rhythm-tuner version that sent it.

since.description: File name of the earlier report the scan was compared with. Absent on a first run (--notify-all-first), when every finding counts as new.

summary.description: One line, e.g. "Tuner: 3 new findings (2 critical, 1 high) on a.test".

counts.description: New findings per severity. Every severity is present, 0 when there are none.

targets.description: Targets with new findings, in scan order.

fingerprint.description: The finding's fingerprint, the same as in the JSON report.

was.description: The severity in the earlier report, when the change of severity is what made it new.

location.description: The finding's URL, or its path inside the scanned folder for a local scan.

new_advisories.description: CVE or advisory IDs the earlier report did not have.
